dictionary.welcome: Welcome to Choose Your Adventure Game
dictionary.menu: Choose; 1. Play (choose or create a character) or 2. Exit. Type '1' or '2'
dictionary.attack_prompt: Enter 'a' to attack or 'r' to retreat.
dictionary.victory: With the dragon vanquished, you collect the horde of gold, return home, rich and famous. The End.
dictionary.defeat: The dragon laughs as your eyesight fades. You are defeated. Your family mourns their loss. The End.
dictionary.retreat: You quickly retreat. You come home poor but alive to adventure another day. The End.
dictionary.retreat_combat: You hastily retreat licking your wounds.
dictionary.profile_name_taken: That name already belongs to another profile. Please choose a different name.
dictionary.profile_file_unreadable: Your saved profiles could not be read. The file was kept as a backup named {0}. Starting with no profiles.
dictionary.profile_file_unreadable_not_moved: Your saved profiles could not be read, and the file could not be kept as a backup. Starting with no profiles. Nothing will be saved this session so the file is not overwritten.
dictionary.profile_save_failed: Warning: your latest progress was NOT saved. You can keep playing.
dictionary.race_prompt: What race of character do you want to be? Human, Elf, Dwarf or Halfling?
dictionary.race_invalid: Invalid race. Please enter Human, Elf, Dwarf, or Halfling.
dictionary.name_prompt: What is the name of your character?
dictionary.occupation_prompt: What is the occupation of your character? Fighter, Magician, Thief, or Archer?
dictionary.occupation_invalid: Invalid occupation. Please enter Fighter, Magician, Thief, or Archer.
dictionary.roll_strength: Next, we are going to roll for strength. Type 'roll'
dictionary.roll_agility: Next, we will roll for agility. Type 'roll'
dictionary.roll_health: Next, we will roll for health points. Type 'roll'
dictionary.roll_gold: Next, we will roll for gold. Type 'roll'
dictionary.next_action: What would you like to do next? 1. List character stats. 2. Proceed on an adventure. Type 1 or 2.
dictionary.path_prompt_full: You are walking in the mountains. You see three paths. One leads north and higher into the mountains. Another leads south and into the woods. The third slopes west, down toward a murky swamp that smells absolutely terrible. Which do you take? Enter 'n' for North. Enter 's' for South. Enter 'w' for West. Enter 'e' for exit game.
dictionary.south_path_narrative: You take the South path into the woods. After a few hours you meet a traveling Merchant leading a mule loaded with strange, glowing wares.
dictionary.merchant_greeting: The Merchant says 'Welcome, traveler! You have {0} Gold. What would you like to buy?'
dictionary.merchant_menu:
1. Magical Armor ({0} Gold)
2. Magical Weapon ({1} Gold)
3. Leave
dictionary.merchant_armor_purchased: You put on the Magical Armor. Your Protection is now {0}.
dictionary.merchant_not_enough_gold: The Merchant shakes his head. 'You do not have enough Gold for that.'
dictionary.merchant_already_owned: The Merchant laughs. 'You already own that!'
dictionary.merchant_farewell: The Merchant waves goodbye. 'Safe travels!' You walk back to where the paths split.
dictionary.north_path_narrative: You take the North path. After walking for hours, the air grows colder, and the trees become more sparse. You are confronted with a dragon. The dragon has a hoard of gold behind it.
dictionary.dragon_intro: The dragon says 'I am {0}. Leave or perish!'
dictionary.dragon_stats_intro: Your magic ring gives you the stats on the dragon.
dictionary.dragon_encounter_prompt: Do you wish to retreat or attack? Enter 'r' for retreat. Enter 'a' for attack.
dictionary.west_path_narrative: You take the West path. The ground turns soft, then squelchy, then frankly disgusting. Deep in the Murky Swamp, something short and green leaps onto a stump, waving an axe and trying very hard to look tall.
dictionary.goblin_intro: The goblin bellows 'OI! I am {0}, Terror of the Murky Swamp! This is MY swamp. Pay the toll or get a face full of axe!'
dictionary.goblin_stats_intro: Your magic ring gives you the stats on the goblin. It seems a little embarrassed to.
dictionary.goblin_encounter_prompt: The goblin taps his foot and pretends he isn't nervous. Do you wish to retreat or attack? Enter 'r' for retreat. Enter 'a' for attack.
dictionary.player_attack_intro: As a {0}, you withdraw your {1} and attack the dragon.
dictionary.dragon_defeated_narrative: With the last words of 'Arggg!', you have defeated the dragon.
dictionary.merchant_weapon_purchased: The Merchant turns your weapon into a Magical Weapon. You now wield a {0} with {1} Maximum Damage Points.
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_1: Missed me, breath of a gnat!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_2: Is that all you've got? I've seen kittens with more fire in their paws!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_3: Try harder, {0}! You're making me yawn!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_4: Maybe if you squinted harder, you'd actually hit something!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_1: Ow! That actually stung a bit!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_2: Impressive! You might actually be worth toasting...
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_3: That... was unexpected. But I assure you, it won't happen again.
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_4: Well, I'll be! You have more bite than I thought!
dictionary.goblin_player_attack_intro: As a {0}, you withdraw your {1} and attack the goblin, who squeaks in a very un-terrifying way.
dictionary.goblin_defeated_narrative: Grubnik wails 'Not the face! NOT THE FACE!' and topples backwards into the mud with a wet SPLAT. You have defeated the goblin.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_1: Ha! Missed! My nan swings harder than that, and she's a mushroom!
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_2: Is that how they fight where you come from, {0}? Pathetic! Also, your boots are ugly.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_3: Too slow! I've been dodging angry frogs since I was a tadpole! ...Since I was a baby. Shut up.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_4: Oi, watch it! This is a VERY expensive swamp!
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_1: OW! Right, that's it, you're paying DOUBLE toll now!
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_2: Hey! I bruise easily! ...I mean, I don't bruise at all. Because I'm terrifying.
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_3: That's going in my book of grudges. Page four hundred and twelve!
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_4: You'll pay for that! Not today, obviously. But some day. Probably.
dictionary.goblin_victory: With Grubnik sobbing in the mud, you search his legendary treasure chest. Inside you find three buttons and a soggy sock. Grubnik insists it's a very valuable sock. You return home no richer, but with an excellent story. The End.
dictionary.goblin_defeat: Your vision blurs as Grubnik does a little victory dance on your chest. He takes your boots, your gold and, for some reason, your left sock. You will never live this down. The End.

dictionary.merchant_greeting: El Mercader dice 'Bienvenido, viajero! Tienes {0} de Oro. Que quieres comprar?'

dictionary.merchant_already_owned: El Mercader se rie. 'Ya tienes eso!'
dictionary.merchant_farewell: El Mercader se despide. 'Buen viaje!' Regresas al cruce de caminos.
dictionary.north_path_narrative: Tomas el camino del norte. Despues de caminar durante horas, el aire se vuelve mas frio y los arboles mas escasos. Te enfrentas a un dragon. El dragon tiene una horda de oro detras de el.

dictionary.west_path_narrative: Tomas el camino del oeste. El suelo se vuelve blando, luego pegajoso, y luego francamente asqueroso. En lo profundo del Pantano Turbio, algo bajito y verde salta sobre un tocon, agitando un hacha y esforzandose mucho por parecer alto.
dictionary.goblin_intro: El goblin grita 'EH! Soy {0}, el Terror del Pantano Turbio! Este es MI pantano. Paga el peaje o te comes mi hacha!'
dictionary.goblin_stats_intro: Tu anillo magico te da las estadisticas del goblin. Parece un poco avergonzado de hacerlo.
dictionary.goblin_encounter_prompt: El goblin golpea el suelo con el pie y finge que no esta nervioso. Deseas retirarte o atacar? Escribe 'r' para retirarte. Escribe 'a' para atacar.
dictionary.player_attack_intro: Como {0}, sacas tu {1} y atacas al dragon.
dictionary.monster_health_now: Los puntos de vida de {0} ahora son {1}.
dictionary.dragon_defeated_narrative: Con las ultimas palabras de 'Arggg!', has derrotado al dragon.
dictionary.armor_absorbed_damage: Tu Armadura Magica absorbe {0} de dano.
dictionary.merchant_weapon_purchased: El Mercader convierte tu arma en un Arma Magica ({0}). Sus Puntos Maximos de Dano ahora son {1}.
dictionary.player_health_now: Los puntos de vida de {0} ahora son {1}.
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_1: Ni me tocaste, aliento de mosquito!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_2: Eso es todo lo que tienes? He visto gatitos con mas fuego en sus patas!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_3: Esfuerzate mas, {0}! Me estas dando sueno!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_4: Tal vez si entrecerraras mas los ojos, de verdad acertarias!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_1: Ay! Eso si dolio un poco!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_2: Impresionante! Tal vez realmente valga la pena tostarte...
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_3: Eso... fue inesperado. Pero te aseguro que no volvera a pasar.
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_4: Vaya! Tienes mas fuerza de la que pensaba!
dictionary.goblin_player_attack_intro: Como {0}, sacas tu {1} y atacas al goblin, que chilla de una forma nada aterradora.
dictionary.goblin_defeated_narrative: Grubnik grita 'En la cara no! EN LA CARA NO!' y cae de espaldas al barro con un CHOF humedo. Has derrotado al goblin.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_1: Ja! Fallaste! Mi abuela golpea mas fuerte, y es una seta!
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_2: Asi pelean de donde vienes, {0}? Patetico! Y tus botas son feas.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_3: Muy lento! Llevo esquivando ranas furiosas desde que era renacuajo! ...Desde que era bebe. Callate.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_4: Eh, cuidado! Este pantano es MUY caro!
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_1: AY! Se acabo, ahora pagas peaje DOBLE!
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_2: Oye! Me salen moretones facilmente! ...Digo, no me salen nunca. Porque soy aterrador.
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_3: Eso va directo a mi libro de rencores. Pagina cuatrocientos doce!
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_4: Me las pagaras! Hoy no, claro. Pero algun dia. Probablemente.
dictionary.goblin_victory: Con Grubnik sollozando en el barro, registras su legendario cofre del tesoro. Dentro encuentras tres botones y un calcetin empapado. Grubnik insiste en que es un calcetin muy valioso. Vuelves a casa sin un centavo mas, pero con una historia excelente. Fin.
dictionary.goblin_defeat: Tu vista se nubla mientras Grubnik baila un bailecito de victoria sobre tu pecho. Se lleva tus botas, tu oro y, por alguna razon, tu calcetin izquierdo. Nunca superaras esta verguenza. Fin.

dictionary.path_prompt_full: Vous marchez dans les montagnes. Vous voyez trois chemins. L'un mene vers le nord et plus haut dans les montagnes. Un autre mene vers le sud et dans les bois. Le troisieme descend vers l'ouest, vers un marais trouble qui sent tres mauvais. Lequel choisissez-vous ? Tapez 'n' pour Nord. Tapez 's' pour Sud. Tapez 'w' pour Ouest. Tapez 'e' pour quitter le jeu.
dictionary.south_path_narrative: Vous prenez le chemin du sud vers les bois. Apres quelques heures, vous rencontrez un Marchand ambulant qui mene une mule chargee de marchandises etranges et brillantes.
dictionary.merchant_greeting: Le Marchand dit 'Bienvenue, voyageur ! Vous avez {0} Or. Que voulez-vous acheter ?'

dictionary.merchant_armor_purchased: Vous enfilez l'Armure Magique. Votre Protection est maintenant de {0}.
dictionary.merchant_not_enough_gold: Le Marchand secoue la tete. 'Vous n'avez pas assez d'Or pour cela.'
dictionary.merchant_already_owned: Le Marchand rit. 'Vous possedez deja cela !'
dictionary.merchant_farewell: Le Marchand vous salue. 'Bon voyage !' Vous retournez au croisement des chemins.
dictionary.north_path_narrative: Vous prenez le chemin du nord. Apres avoir marche pendant des heures, l'air devient plus froid et les arbres plus rares. Vous etes confronte a un dragon. Le dragon a un tresor d'or derriere lui.
dictionary.dragon_intro: Le dragon dit 'Je suis {0}. Pars ou peris !'
dictionary.dragon_stats_intro: Votre anneau magique vous donne les statistiques du dragon.
dictionary.dragon_encounter_prompt: Souhaitez-vous vous retirer ou attaquer ? Tapez 'r' pour vous retirer. Tapez 'a' pour attaquer.
dictionary.west_path_narrative: Vous prenez le chemin de l'ouest. Le sol devient mou, puis spongieux, puis franchement degoutant. Au fond du Marais Trouble, une petite chose verte bondit sur une souche en agitant une hache et en faisant de gros efforts pour paraitre grande.
dictionary.goblin_intro: Le gobelin hurle 'OH ! Je suis {0}, la Terreur du Marais Trouble ! C'est MON marais. Paie le peage ou tu vas gouter a ma hache !'
dictionary.goblin_stats_intro: Votre anneau magique vous donne les statistiques du gobelin. Il semble un peu gene de le faire.
dictionary.goblin_encounter_prompt: Le gobelin tape du pied et fait semblant de ne pas etre nerveux. Souhaitez-vous vous retirer ou attaquer ? Tapez 'r' pour vous retirer. Tapez 'a' pour attaquer.
dictionary.player_attack_intro: En tant que {0}, vous sortez votre {1} et attaquez le dragon.
dictionary.monster_health_now: Les points de vie de {0} sont maintenant de {1}.
dictionary.dragon_defeated_narrative: Avec les derniers mots 'Arggg!', vous avez vaincu le dragon.
dictionary.merchant_weapon_purchased: Le Marchand transforme votre arme en Arme Magique ({0}). Ses Points de Dommages Maximum sont maintenant de {1}.
dictionary.player_health_now: Les points de vie de {0} sont maintenant de {1}.
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_1: Tu m'as rate, souffle de moucheron!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_2: C'est tout ce que tu as? J'ai vu des chatons avec plus de feu dans leurs pattes!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_3: Essaie plus fort, {0}! Tu me fais bailler!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_4: Peut-etre qu'en plissant davantage les yeux, tu pourrais vraiment toucher!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_1: Aie! Ca a pique un peu!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_2: Impressionnant! Tu vaux peut-etre vraiment la peine d'etre grille...
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_3: C'etait... inattendu. Mais je t'assure que cela ne se reproduira pas.
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_4: Eh bien! Tu as plus de mordant que je ne le pensais!
dictionary.goblin_player_attack_intro: En tant que {0}, vous sortez votre {1} et attaquez le gobelin, qui couine d'une facon pas du tout terrifiante.
dictionary.goblin_defeated_narrative: Grubnik gemit 'Pas le visage ! PAS LE VISAGE !' et bascule en arriere dans la boue avec un gros SPLOTCH. Vous avez vaincu le gobelin.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_1: Ha ! Rate ! Ma grand-mere frappe plus fort que ca, et c'est un champignon !
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_2: C'est comme ca qu'on se bat chez toi, {0} ? Pathetique ! Et tes bottes sont moches.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_3: Trop lent ! J'esquive des grenouilles en colere depuis que je suis tetard ! ...Depuis que je suis bebe. Tais-toi.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_4: Oh, attention ! C'est un marais TRES cher !
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_1: AIE ! Ca suffit, tu paies le DOUBLE du peage maintenant !
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_2: Eh ! J'ai des bleus facilement ! ...Enfin, je n'ai jamais de bleus. Parce que je suis terrifiant.
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_3: Ca va dans mon livre des rancunes. Page quatre cent douze !
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_4: Tu vas me le payer ! Pas aujourd'hui, evidemment. Mais un jour. Probablement.
dictionary.goblin_victory: Pendant que Grubnik sanglote dans la boue, vous fouillez son legendaire coffre au tresor. Dedans, vous trouvez trois boutons et une chaussette trempee. Grubnik insiste : c'est une chaussette de tres grande valeur. Vous rentrez chez vous pas plus riche, mais avec une excellente histoire. Fin.
dictionary.goblin_defeat: Votre vue se brouille pendant que Grubnik fait une petite danse de la victoire sur votre poitrine. Il prend vos bottes, votre or et, on ne sait pourquoi, votre chaussette gauche. Vous ne vous en remettrez jamais. Fin.

dictionary.merchant_armor_purchased: Indossi l'Armatura Magica. La tua Protezione ora e {0}.
dictionary.merchant_not_enough_gold: Il Mercante scuote la testa. 'Non hai abbastanza Oro per questo.'
dictionary.merchant_farewell: Il Mercante ti saluta. 'Buon viaggio!' Torni al bivio.
dictionary.north_path_narrative: Prendi il sentiero a nord. Dopo ore di cammino, l'aria si fa piu fredda e gli alberi diventano piu radi. Ti trovi di fronte a un drago. Il drago ha un tesoro d'oro alle sue spalle.
dictionary.dragon_intro: Il drago dice 'Io sono {0}. Vattene o perisci!'
dictionary.dragon_stats_intro: Il tuo anello magico ti mostra le statistiche del drago.
dictionary.dragon_encounter_prompt: Vuoi ritirarti o attaccare? Scrivi 'r' per ritirarti. Scrivi 'a' per attaccare.
dictionary.west_path_narrative: Prendi il sentiero a ovest. Il terreno diventa morbido, poi fangoso, poi decisamente disgustoso. Nel cuore della Palude Torbida, qualcosa di basso e verde salta su un ceppo, agitando un'ascia e sforzandosi tantissimo di sembrare alto.
dictionary.goblin_intro: Il goblin urla 'EHI! Io sono {0}, il Terrore della Palude Torbida! Questa e la MIA palude. Paga il pedaggio o assaggerai la mia ascia!'
dictionary.goblin_stats_intro: Il tuo anello magico ti mostra le statistiche del goblin. Sembra un po' imbarazzato a farlo.
dictionary.goblin_encounter_prompt: Il goblin batte il piede e finge di non essere nervoso. Vuoi ritirarti o attaccare? Scrivi 'r' per ritirarti. Scrivi 'a' per attaccare.
dictionary.player_attack_intro: Come {0}, estrai il tuo {1} e attacchi il drago.
dictionary.monster_defended_player_attack: {0} para con successo il tuo attacco.
dictionary.monster_health_now: I punti vita di {0} ora sono {1}.
dictionary.dragon_defeated_narrative: Con le ultime parole 'Arggg!', hai sconfitto il drago.
dictionary.armor_absorbed_damage: La tua Armatura Magica assorbe {0} danni.
dictionary.merchant_weapon_purchased: Il Mercante trasforma la tua arma in un'Arma Magica ({0}). Il suo Danno Massimo ora e {1}.
dictionary.player_health_now: I punti vita di {0} ora sono {1}.
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_2: Tutto qui? Ho visto gattini con piu fuoco nelle zampe!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_3: Impegnati di piu, {0}! Mi fai sbadigliare!
dictionary.dragon_defense_taunt_4: Forse se strizzassi di piu gli occhi, colpiresti davvero qualcosa!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_1: Ahi! Questo ha fatto un po' male!
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_2: Notevole! Forse vale davvero la pena arrostirti...
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_3: Questo... era inaspettato. Ma ti assicuro che non succedera di nuovo.
dictionary.dragon_damage_reply_4: Ma guarda! Hai piu grinta di quanto pensassi!
dictionary.goblin_player_attack_intro: Come {0}, estrai il tuo {1} e attacchi il goblin, che squittisce in modo per niente terrificante.
dictionary.goblin_defeated_narrative: Grubnik strilla 'Non la faccia! NON LA FACCIA!' e cade all'indietro nel fango con uno SPLASH bagnato. Hai sconfitto il goblin.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_1: Ah! Mancato! Mia nonna colpisce piu forte, ed e un fungo!
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_2: E cosi che si combatte da dove vieni, {0}? Patetico! E i tuoi stivali sono brutti.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_3: Troppo lento! Schivo rane arrabbiate da quando ero un girino! ...Da quando ero piccolo. Zitto.
dictionary.goblin_defense_taunt_4: Ehi, attento! Questa e una palude MOLTO costosa!
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_1: AHIA! Basta, adesso paghi il pedaggio DOPPIO!
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_2: Ehi! Mi vengono i lividi facilmente! ...Cioe, non mi vengono mai. Perche sono terrificante.
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_3: Questa finisce nel mio libro dei rancori. Pagina quattrocentododici!
dictionary.goblin_damage_reply_4: Me la pagherai! Non oggi, ovviamente. Ma un giorno. Probabilmente.
dictionary.goblin_victory: Mentre Grubnik singhiozza nel fango, frughi nel suo leggendario forziere del tesoro. Dentro trovi tre bottoni e un calzino fradicio. Grubnik insiste che e un calzino molto prezioso. Torni a casa non piu ricco, ma con una storia fantastica. Fine.
dictionary.goblin_defeat: La tua vista si annebbia mentre Grubnik fa un balletto della vittoria sul tuo petto. Si prende i tuoi stivali, il tuo oro e, chissa perche, il tuo calzino sinistro. Non te lo perdonerai mai. Fine.
